task: M9 Task3G requirements and contradiction audit

requirements.KB-007: Ambiguous sources may use structured AI classification.
requirements.KB-008: Mixed sources extract stable knowledge while dynamic facts remain live.
requirements.KB-012: Auto-approval requires safe source class plus configured validation/confidence.
requirements.KB-014: Current/live values are not stored as durable authoritative facts.
requirements.KB-013: Lifecycle includes approved, needs-review, draft/manual, retired.

contradiction.prompt: review means content that cannot be safely classified or separated, has policy/effective-date ambiguity, would lose critical qualifications, has low confidence, or fails stable/dynamic validation.
contradiction.validator: from_array rejects either Boolean flag false unconditionally for every source kind; type/presence checks remain mandatory.
contradiction.finding: A schema-valid review can describe unsafe separation/qualification with false flags yet is marked application-invalid.

lifecycle_safety_boundaries.requires_review: Explicit review always requires review, independently of confidence.
lifecycle_safety_boundaries.auto_approval: should_auto_approve only permits static_knowledge; review is excluded before confidence checks.
lifecycle_safety_boundaries.scanner_review: Review processing persists a review-state artifact, not mixed fragments or approved knowledge.
lifecycle_safety_boundaries.retrieval: is_active_artifact excludes review, draft, retired and unknown states.

implementation_authorized: Two false-value branches conditional on source_kind != review; no prompt/schema change.
